causes.label: Cache expired (resumed after a long break)
causes.fix: Resumed 4 times after a gap longer than the prompt-cache lifetime (Claude Code: 5 minutes or 1 hour, as each cache write records; Codex: 30 minutes on GPT-5.6 and later). After a long break, leave a short summary and start a new session instead.

causes.label: Cache rewritten mid-session (after a model/settings/tool change)
causes.fix: The cache was rewritten right after model change x2, reasoning-effort change x1, tool-list change x1, system prompt / tool set change x1 (5 times). Choose model, reasoning effort and tools when the session starts and do not change them midway.

causes.label: Cache rewritten mid-session (cause unknown)
causes.fix: 1 rewrites with no preceding event in the log; most likely server-side cache eviction. Nothing to fix (amount recorded only).

causes.label: Same command repeated (3rd run onward)
causes.fix: 5 calls ran a command for at least the third time. If it is status polling, have the agent wait for a completion signal; add "stop and explain before running the same command a third time" to your instructions.

causes.label: Consecutive failures
causes.fix: 8 calls failed right after another failure. "Stop and report the cause after two failures in a row" in your instructions breaks the loop.

causes.label: Unchanged file read again
causes.fix: 2 calls re-read the same range of a file that had not changed. Put the key file locations and layout in the first request.

causes.label: Oversized tool output (over 10k tokens)
causes.fix: 3 tool outputs over 10k tokens entered the context and were re-read by every later response. Have logs and test output tailed or summarized.

habits.label: Resuming the same session after a long break
habits.tip: After a gap longer than the cache lifetime (Claude Code: 5 min or 1 h, Codex: 30 min), leave a summary and start a new session.

habits.label: Switching model, reasoning effort or tools mid-session
habits.tip: Pick model, reasoning effort, MCP servers and tools when the session starts; switch in a new session.

habits.label: Letting the agent repeat or retry the same command
habits.tip: Add "stop and explain after two failures in a row or before running the same command a third time" to CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md, and prefer completion signals over polling.

habits.label: Not telling the agent where the key files are (it re-reads them)
habits.tip: Put the key file locations and layout in the first request or in your instructions file.

habits.label: Letting long logs and outputs into the context whole
habits.tip: Ask the agent to read only the tail or a summary of test and build logs.

automation_fixes.label: Codex automation (heartbeat turns injected into an existing thread)
tips: Each run continues the same thread after a long gap, so the expired context is cached again (1 time, $0.01). Run each time in a new thread, or pass the needed context as a short summary file.
